content:
ellie (AE): Heads-up: Aurelia Finance is gating the POC on compliance artifacts + a quick pricing Q. They want: SOC2 attestation (will accept full report under NDA), ISO27001 cert, signed pen-test attestation (must call out inference runtime + admin console), a sanitized network diagram, staging ingress CIDRs, and clarification whether FIPS-compatible KMS requires Dedicated/Private. Also ask for an estimated monthly delta for a 60-day Dedicated trial vs Hosted. Can someone assemble the evidence pack and provision a presigned upload for them to drop diagrams?

devin (SE): I can own the bundle and the Hosted vs Dedicated delta. Quick clarifier: we normally provide SOC2 attestation and control summary immediately; full SOC2 PDF goes to dataroom after NDA. KMS: FIPS key stores are only available on Private deployments today; Dedicated requires extra onboarding. I'll draft a cost delta (60-day pro-rate + onboarding fee) and drop in the dataroom.

frank (Security): Pen-test attestation: we provide a signed letter listing scope, test date, and the 3rd-party vendor. We do not share raw findings without redaction and legal approval. If they require Dedicated nodes in-scope for the pen-test, that adds ~2 weeks and an infra addendum. For wording, request they include "inference runtime, KV-cache, and administrative console" if they want full coverage. Signatory must be a named security lead.

ellie (AE): Perfect. They also requested a presigned upload for several files (network diagrams + firewall rules + a short SOC2 recipient NDA). They prefer a multi-file POST. Can we give them a 48h presigned POST with server-side encryption and no public ACL?

devin (SE): Yes. We'll create a one-off presigned POST scoped to folder DR-11400 with 48h expiry, SSE-S3, and strict ACL=private. Example curl I give customers:

```
curl -X POST "<PRESIGNED_POST_URL>" \ 
  -F "key=uploads/aurelia/${filename}" \ 
  -F "policy=<BASE64_POLICY>" \ 
  -F "x-amz-signature=<SIG>" \ 
  -F "file=@diagram.png"
```

devin (SE): I'll provision DR-11400 and paste the presigned POST + short HOWTO once ready. ETA: 2 hours. Also will include a simple ingress placeholder doc with ephemeral CIDRs for firewall pre-config so their infra team can prep.

lara (Legal): NDA + pen-test attestation template available. Note: full SOC2 requires executed NDA before upload. Pen-test attestation requires legal review of the final wording and a named security signer; we cannot auto-sign. If Aurelia requests CVE/issue-level data we must run the redaction process and legal sign-off before release.

frank (Security): One more security note: if they request FIPS KMS for key custody during POC, that triggers Private deployment discussions and an infra onboarding fee — we should call this out in the pricing delta. Also clarify whether they need crypto proofs (FIPS validation doc) or just confirmation of FIPS support.

dataroom-bot: Secure dataroom created: DR-11400. Presigned POST uploads enabled. Access: ellie, devin, frank, lara.

devin (SE): Dropping checklist into DR-11400: SOC2 attestation (pdf), ISO27001 cert (pdf), draft pen-test attestation (unsigned), sanitized network diagram template (png), ingress CIDR placeholders (txt), and Hosted vs Dedicated 60-day delta (pdf). Will upload full SOC2 after NDA.

ellie (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll ask Aurelia for CISO name/title for signer and whether they need FIPS validation docs vs just KMS compatibility confirmation. Also asking for their primary email and desired filenames for the upload. Will update here when they reply. :white_check_mark:
